js: const s = window.__ensemble.getState(); await s.send('Add a pricing page', undefined, undefined, { goal: { doneWhen: 'the tests pass and the page was opened' } }); const w = await window.__r.until(c => c.goal && c.goal.status === 'active', 20000); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 1500)); return 'waited ' + w + ' ms | ' + window.__r.state();
const w = await window.__r.until(c => c.goal.checking, 20000); return 'waited ' + w + ' ms | ' + window.__r.state();
const w = await window.__r.until(c => c.goal.round === 1 && !c.goal.checking, 20000); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 1800)); return 'waited ' + w + ' ms | ' + window.__r.state();
const w = await window.__r.until(c => c.goal.status === 'met', 30000); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 1300)); return 'waited ' + w + ' ms | ' + window.__r.state();
const ok = window.__r.click('More about this goal'); return 'expand ' + ok;
window.__r.click('Less'); return 'top ' + window.__r.top();

const s = window.__ensemble.getState(); await s.send('Check whether the deploy is live', undefined, undefined, { loop: { every: 600000, until: 'the deploy is live' } }); const w = await window.__r.until(c => (c.loops || []).some(l => l.running), 20000); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 300)); return 'waited ' + w + ' ms | ' + window.__r.state();

const w = await window.__r.until(c => (c.loops || []).some(l => l.runs === 1 && !l.running && l.nextAt), 20000); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 1500)); return 'waited ' + w + ' ms | ' + window.__r.state();

const ok = window.__r.click('Run now'); const w = await window.__r.until(c => (c.loops || []).some(l => l.runs === 2 && !l.running && l.nextAt), 20000); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 1000)); return 'waited ' + w + ' ms | ' + window.__r.state();
window.__ensemble.getState().setView('now'); return window.__r.state();

window.__ensemble.getState().setView('chat'); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 800)); const ok = window.__r.click('Pause'); const w = await window.__r.until(c => (c.loops || []).some(l => l.status === 'paused'), 20000); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 600)); return 'waited ' + w + ' ms | ' + window.__r.state();

const ok = window.__r.click('Resume'); await window.__r.until(c => c.loops.some(l => l.status === 'active'), 5000); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 400)); window.__r.click('Run now'); const w = await window.__r.until(c => (c.loops || []).every(l => l.status === 'done'), 20000); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 1500)); return 'waited ' + w + ' ms | ' + window.__r.state();

const ok = window.__r.click('Take the goal off'); const w = await window.__r.until(c => !c.goal, 20000); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 900)); return 'waited ' + w + ' ms | ' + window.__r.state();
const el = document.querySelector('.overflow-y-auto.h-full'); if (el) el.scrollTop = el.scrollHeight; return 'bottom';

const s = window.__ensemble.getState(); s.newChat(); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 600)); await window.__ensemble.getState().send('Add a pricing page', undefined, undefined, { goal: { maxRounds: 1 } }); const w = await window.__r.until(c => c.goal && c.goal.status === 'stopped', 30000); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 900)); return 'waited ' + w + ' ms | ' + window.__r.state();

const ok = window.__r.click('Give it more rounds'); const w = await window.__r.until(c => c.goal.status === 'active', 20000); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 1200)); return 'waited ' + w + ' ms | ' + window.__r.state();

const ok = window.__r.click('Pause'); const w = await window.__r.until(c => c.goal.status === 'paused', 20000); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 600)); return 'waited ' + w + ' ms | ' + window.__r.state();

const ok = window.__r.click('Stop working on this goal'); const w = await window.__r.until(c => c.goal.status === 'stopped', 20000); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 600)); return 'waited ' + w + ' ms | ' + window.__r.state();

const ok = window.__r.click('Pick it up again'); const w = await window.__r.until(c => c.goal.status === 'active', 20000); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 800)); return 'waited ' + w + ' ms | ' + window.__r.state();
window.__ensemble.getState().setView('now'); return window.__r.state();

window.__ensemble.getState().setView('chat'); const st = window.__ensemble; const id = st.getState().chatId; st.setState(s => ({ chats: s.chats.map(c => c.id === id ? { ...c, goal: { ...c.goal, status: 'blocked', checking: false, note: 'Needs the Stripe test key to run the checkout test. Add it to .env, then say carry on.' } } : c) })); return 'faked blocked';
